fact_text: The analyst's Parabolic SAR method opens a short after a candle closes beyond the SAR dots, places the stop beyond the last candle, and sets a reward-to-risk target of about 1:2 to 1:5.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mastering Parabolic SAR for Stock Analysis | PSX Equity Market Insights | Pakistan Stock Market Tips' (YouTube, 2025-03-01)

fact_text: The analyst uses a 200-period exponential moving average as a trend filter, taking only long-side setups when price trades above it and only short-side setups when below.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mastering Parabolic SAR for Stock Analysis | PSX Equity Market Insights | Pakistan Stock Market Tips' (YouTube, 2025-03-01)

fact_text: The analyst said Parabolic SAR works best in trending markets and tends to produce repeated stop-outs when the market moves sideways in consolidation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mastering Parabolic SAR for Stock Analysis | PSX Equity Market Insights | Pakistan Stock Market Tips' (YouTube, 2025-03-01)

fact_text: The analyst described switching from the daily chart to a shorter timeframe to time day-trade entries with the Parabolic SAR indicator applied.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mastering Parabolic SAR for Stock Analysis | PSX Equity Market Insights | Pakistan Stock Market Tips' (YouTube, 2025-03-01)
